description:
Uses official MorpheApp MicroG-RE 7.2.1 and prefers readable synthesized navigation speech while retaining Maps' existing audio fallback and voice selection.

Our Maps sign-in and location fixes were merged upstream in [MicroG-RE PR #272](https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/272) and are included in 7.2.1. We now use the official provider; the separate BYD fork is no longer maintained.

- Resolves navigation TTS hooks generically and rejects ambiguous or unrecognized layouts.
- Adds BYD setup instructions and a download link for [patched Google TTS](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-tts-microg).

Download `patches-1.2.2.mpp` below, or refresh this repository's source in Morphe Desktop. Patch a clean Google Maps APK with **Google Maps for MicroG-RE**.

The latest tested Maps version is `26.39.06.984891338`: static checks passed, and the user confirmed normal use and TTS on BYD DiLink 3.0 / Android 10 / ARM64 / 4 KiB pages. Separate recorded BYD tests covered Thai street-name speech, English place-name speech and speech after vehicle restart. Other firmware, 16 KiB devices, English-script street-name maneuvers and automatic voice timing while driving remain unverified.

For voice downloads, use the exact MicroG-RE APK specified in the TTS guide. On BYD, turn OFF **Disable Autostart** for MicroG RE and Google TTS, then download Thai and English (US) voices. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/fangkampanat/gmaps-patches#install-microg-re).

Thanks to [rananga](https://github.com/rananga) for the navigation TTS approach proposed in [PR #8](https://github.com/fangkampanat/gmaps-patches/pull/8).
